text:
```yaml
name: Lint Objective-C New Usage
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**/*.m'
      - '**/*.h'
      - '**/*.mm'
      - '**/*.hpp'
      - '**/*.cpp'
      - '**/*.cc'
      - '**/*.c'
      - '.github/workflows/lint-objc-new.yml'

jobs:
  lint-objc-new:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.0'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install rexml

      - name: Check for [new] usage
        run: |
          # Find all occurrences of [ClassName new] pattern
          find . -type f \( -name "*.m" -o -name "*.h" -o -name "*.mm" \) -exec grep -l "\[.*new\]" {} \; | while read -r file; do
            if grep -n "\[.*new\]" "$file" | grep -v "^\s*//\|^\s*/\*\|^\s*\*\|^\s*\/\*" > /dev/null; then
              echo "Found [new] usage in $file:"
              grep -n "\[.*new\]" "$file" | grep -v "^\s*//\|^\s*/\*\|^\s*\*\|^\s*\/\*" | sed "s/^/$file:/"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "No [new] usage found - all good!"
```
